## About
Extreme Tire & Wheel is a family owned tire shop at 3021 W Northwest Hwy in Dallas. We carry Toyo and Hankook tires and also handle wheel alignment, tire changes, muffler replacement and state inspections.
We know life without a car can be hard, so our shop has multiple service bays to get you back on the road as soon as we can. While you wait, you can read a book or listen to music in our spacious waiting room.
We're open weekdays and weekends. Give us a call to ask about tires or to schedule an appointment. Our customers rate us 4.6 from 347 Google reviews.

## Services
- Toyo and Hankook tires: New tires from Toyo and Hankook to keep your ride safe and comfortable.
- Tire change and wheel alignment: Swap out old, worn tires and get your wheels lined up properly.
- State inspection: Bring your car in when it's time for its annual state inspection.
- Muffler replacement: We replace mufflers on cars and trucks that need one.
- Auto repair: Along with tires, we handle auto repair and outfitting services.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. We're open on weekdays and weekends. Call ahead to confirm our hours for the day.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can call us to schedule an appointment, or send us your questions through the contact form and we'll get back to you.

Q: Can you get tires that are hard to find?
A: One reviewer with a Smart Car said her tires are rarely in stock, so she special orders them and has them shipped to us. We called her when they arrived.
